title: Women players and trumpeter Dolly Hutchinson
summary: Punch never taught women except trumpeter Dolly Hutchinson in Chicago, who learned from him daily and played tough.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Did a lot of women Play musical instruments
Do you have any women in the band?
No I never taught no women But one girl Her name was Dara I believe you heard of her Well in Chicago She'd come around me every day And learn stuff Oh Dara Hutchinson She could play She was tough
She was like Louie Yeah She could play like Louie She was a hard rock
Little bitter little girl But she could blow on
How big was she? Was she fat?
No Dara Hutchinson A little small No
